_about: Split Shift mission nodes (mission-framework SS). Mission part only: validate with Sector Ops' campus plan graphs, `node scripts/level-validate.mjs docs/sector-redesign/graph/plan/campusOps-S{1,2,3,4,5}.json <this file>` (mission-validator branch). Space and sync ids are Sector Ops' (origin/feature/sector-redesign-signoff fe3ef35f, graph/plan/campusOps-S2.json `syncs`). `sync` on an objective names the campus sync node the step uses and `assist` an optional one (neither is a validator field). The extraction s2-l1-landing is Sector Ops' `tracks.exfil` in that file, not a space tag. Beat chart: BEAT.md; differences and node needs: BEAT.md 'Graph notes'.

objectives.text: Up the post room's fire stair; listen at the first-floor kitchen for the facilities code
objectives.hint: The kitchen is the lit room off the west balcony. Stand at its door, out of the lamp.

objectives.text: Take the plant log from the mail room cages, behind the goods-door guard
objectives.hint: He faces into the room. The cages are behind his left shoulder.

objectives.text: Loop the ground-floor cameras at the comms room patch panel
objectives.hint: Wait for the checker to leave the panel. He comes back every forty seconds.

objectives.text: Cut the east wing at the switchgear in the east plant room
objectives.hint: The plant room door is in the foyer's east wall, behind the desk's back.

objectives.text: Into the dark facilities office and hack the BMS terminal
objectives.hint: The office door is beside the corridor light switch. Leave the switch alone.

objectives.text: Hold the plant room dark until Ghost is out of the office
objectives.hint: Two of them now. The atrium board is on the foyer wall. He always fixes his own lights first.

objectives.text: Optional: photograph the lighting schedule on the board room wall, second floor
objectives.hint: Second floor, north-east corner. The stair-tour officer never comes this far.

objectives.text: Everyone to the bridge landing and over the glazed bridge
objectives.hint: Shadow: the north-east fire stair from the hall. The bridge officer faces the doorways.

tracks.name: Ghost
tracks.note: Upstairs: L1 and L2 share the ground floor's plan footprint, so S2's tracks split by storey (y), not by plan box (EN2).

tracks.name: Shadow
tracks.note: Ground floor. The bridge landing (zone c2) is in neither track: shared.
